author: piztanza
description: Rewire the waitlist backend (F-008) to the platform's EXISTING production table partner_signups (no DDL/migrations ever): drizzle models the live table verbatim (uuid + updatedAt generated at insert; status/createdAt left to DB defaults; triage columns never written); API contract mirrors the platform's /api/partners/signup (partnerType uppercase enum, contactPhone, currentToolsUsed/brandsCarried arrays, whitelisted city/volume/tools, _honeypot silent fake-200); source='LANDING_MOBEELI_COM'; wizard client sends the new shape; Resend alert kept; migration files deleted.
acceptance_criteria: No migration/DDL artifacts remain in the repo; the drizzle schema mirrors the introspected partner_signups table exactly (camelCase quoted columns, PartnerType/PartnerSignupStatus enums)

Insert sets id (crypto.randomUUID) and updatedAt (now), sends source='LANDING_MOBEELI_COM', and never writes status, createdAt, utm, sessionId, or triage columns — unit test asserts the exact insert shape
Validation matches the platform API: businessName required; email/phone regexes; city/volume/tools whitelists; array limits (tools ≤10×60, brands ≤20×60); message ≤2000; unknown values → 400
_honeypot non-empty → silent {ok:true} without insert or email
Wizard sends the new payload (uppercase partnerType, arrays, contactPhone, _honeypot) with unchanged UI/copy; lang used only for the alert email, never inserted
JSONL fallback mirrors the same field names when DATABASE_URL is unset
Resend alert renders the new field names and includes source; suite green with updated tests
